claims.sentence: Analysis set: the 1,802 / 2,075 / 2,188 named global tasks with a wage and at least one classified collaboration cell — 97.15 / 96.23 / 96.52% of the conversations mapped to a named task, on 818,673 / 854,432 / 848,716 classified conversations, Kish effective 94 / 83 / 126 tasks; 805 / 1,079 / 1,056 tasks with a wage and no classified cell and 5 / 12 / 12 with a cell and no wage are dropped, never zeroed.

claims.section: Methodology

claims.section: Methodology
claims.sentence: Every confirmatory quantity is produced twice by two independent code paths; the largest disagreement in the headline difference between them is 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁴ points, the bootstrap standard errors are within 0.9% of the closed form, and their intervals cover 95.2–95.3%.

claims.section: What was set in advance
claims.sentence: The assumed effect and its provenance: a smallest effect of interest of one percentage point on the difference, chosen so that the rule could fail, with a realised minimum detectable effect of 0.40 / 0.39 / 0.39 points per week at 80% power.
